## Description {#details}

<p>This provides a very simple, boring adaptor for a begin and end iterator into a range type.</p>


<p>This should be used to build range views that work well with range based for loops and range based constructors.</p>


<p>Note that code here follows more standards-based coding conventions as it is mirroring proposed interfaces for standardization.</p>
